_comment: Beads this image resolves. One JSON object per line, appended by hand when work merges. Fields: id (the prod bead, kb-...), summary (what shipped, quoted into the bead note), commit (the sha to audit it against). On startup app/kb.py:reconcile_shipped closes each id in every per-user ledger on this machine, exactly once, stamped with the image ref. Lines starting with _comment are ignored. See docs/decisions/0010.
